Access plotly events in Shiny

Source: R/shiny.R
event_data.Rd

Returns the data of the most recent plotly event of a given type, from the plot with the given source (see event_source()); NULL before any such event. Must be called in a reactive context of a Shiny app.

Usage

event_data(
  event = c("plotly_hover", "plotly_unhover", "plotly_click", "plotly_doubleclick",
    "plotly_selected", "plotly_selecting", "plotly_brushed", "plotly_brushing",
    "plotly_deselect", "plotly_relayout", "plotly_restyle", "plotly_legendclick",
    "plotly_legenddoubleclick", "plotly_clickannotation", "plotly_afterplot",
    "plotly_sunburstclick"),
  source = "A",
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(),
  priority = c("input", "event")
)

Arguments

event

The event type.

source

The source id of the plot.

session

The Shiny session.

priority

"input" (default) triggers reactivity only when the value changes; "event" on every event, even with the same value.

Value

Event data, or NULL.

Details

Point events (click, hover, selected, ...) return a data frame with curveNumber, pointNumber, x, y and, where available, z, customdata and key. plotly_relayout returns the changed layout properties (e.g. axis ranges after zooming).

Examples

if (interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ui <- shiny::fluidPage(plotlyOutput("plot"), shiny::verbatimTextOutput("click"))
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    output$plot <- renderPlotly(
      iris |> go_figure() |> add_scatter(x = ~Sepal.Width, y = ~Sepal.Length, mode = "markers")
    )
    output$click <- shiny::renderPrint(event_data("plotly_click"))
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
